findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "create_prereservation" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Use this when the user wants to book, reserve a place, sign up a child or children, or book for a group for one specific Horseback event or group activity from …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
